notes: The repository lock file at the base commit is used verbatim; npm ci resolves every package from it.
Dependencies are npm registry artifacts published before the cutoff as pinned by the lock; no toolchain overrides needed.
fd-find and ripgrep are installed from Debian bookworm so pi's tools-manager finds them on PATH and never downloads at runtime.

Model catalog: pi's normal build regenerates packages/ai/src/providers/data from live APIs, which made the image depend on its build date and broke every fresh build on 2026-09-19. The catalog is taken from the published pi-ai 0.85.1 package instead and pi is built with network disabled. That package was published 11 minutes after dependency_cutoff, but it is the build of the base commit itself (base_commit is the 'Release v0.85.1' commit; the package's 177 dist .js files are byte-identical to this image's build), so it carries nothing later than the base commit. The 0.85.0 package predates the cutoff but lacks gpt-6-astra, which the base commit's sources and ai tests reference. See templates/pi-harbor-node/README.md, 'Model catalog'.
